grades.quote: If CSR.TLBRERA.IsTLBR=1, then the E bit of the TLB entry being written is always set to 1, regardless of the value of that bit.
grades.reason: Explains one effect of IsTLBR on TLB-entry writes, but not its purpose as an exception-context flag.
Provides only the flag's reset value, not its purpose or exception-handling effects.

grades.quote:
|Bits|Name|Read/Write|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|0|IsTLBR|RW|1 indicates that it is currently in the context of TLB refill exception processing.|
||||The hardware sets this bit to 1 when a TLB refill exception is triggered. When this bit is 1, execution of the ERTN instruction will clear it to 0 only if CSR.MERRCTL.IsMERR=0, otherwise it remains unchanged.
grades.reason: Directly explains the flag's purpose, setting and conditional clearing, and further describes its selection of refill-specific exception state.
Lists TLB instruction sections but provides no information about TLBRERA.IsTLBR.
